explanation_bn: cos(−π/3) = cos(π/3); cos⁻¹ এর রেঞ্জে মান π/3।

stem_en: If xy > 1 and x > 0, y > 0, then tan⁻¹ x + tan⁻¹ y equals:
stem_bn: xy > 1 এবং x > 0, y > 0 হলে tan⁻¹ x + tan⁻¹ y এর মান কত?
explanation_en: When xy > 1 and x, y > 0, both angles are in (0, π/2) and their sum exceeds π/2, so tan⁻¹ x + tan⁻¹ y = π + tan⁻¹((x + y)/(1 − xy)) = π − tan⁻¹((x + y)/(xy − 1)).
explanation_bn: xy > 1, x,y > 0 হলে যোগফল π/2 অতিক্রম করে; মান π − tan⁻¹((x + y)/(xy − 1))।
source: Udvash HSC Question Bank 2026; licensed redistribution; higher_mathematics p2 ch07; curated bilingual

stem_en: Which are true? (i) sin⁻¹(−x) = −sin⁻¹ x for −1 ≤ x ≤ 1 (ii) sin(sin⁻¹ (π/2)) = π/2 (iii) sec⁻¹(−x) = π − sec⁻¹ x for |x| ≥ 1
stem_bn: বিপরীত বৃত্তীয় ফাংশনের ক্ষেত্রে— (i) −1 ≤ x ≤ 1 হলে sin⁻¹(−x) = −sin⁻¹ x (ii) sin(sin⁻¹ (π/2)) = π/2 (iii) |x| ≥ 1 হলে sec⁻¹(−x) = π − sec⁻¹ x — কোনটি সঠিক?
explanation_en: (i) and (iii) are standard identities. (ii) is false because π/2 ∉ [−1, 1], so sin⁻¹(π/2) is undefined.
explanation_bn: (i) ও (iii) সঠিক; (ii) মিথ্যা কারণ π/2 ডোমেনের বাইরে।
source: Udvash HSC Question Bank 2026; licensed redistribution; higher_mathematics p2 ch07; curated bilingual

explanation_bn: x < 0 হলে tan⁻¹ x + tan⁻¹(1/x) = −π/2।

stem_en: Which inverse-trigonometric identity is correct (for x ≥ 0)?
stem_bn: নিচের কোন বিপরীত ত্রিকোণমিতিক অভেদটি সঠিক (x ≥ 0)?
option_a_bn: মান 2 tan⁻¹ x = cos⁻¹((1 − x²)/(1 + x²))
option_b_bn: মান 2 tan⁻¹ x = sin⁻¹((1 − x²)/(1 + x²))
option_c_en: 3 tan⁻¹ x = tan⁻¹((3x − x³)/(1 − 3x²)) for all real x
option_c_bn: সকল বাস্তব x এর জন্য 3 tan⁻¹ x = tan⁻¹((3x − x³)/(1 − 3x²))
option_d_en: 2 cos⁻¹ x = cos⁻¹(2x² − 1) for all x ∈ [−1, 1]
option_d_bn: সকল x ∈ [−1, 1] এর জন্য 2 cos⁻¹ x = cos⁻¹(2x² − 1)
explanation_en: For x ≥ 0, 2 tan⁻¹ x = cos⁻¹((1 − x²)/(1 + x²)). Option B uses the wrong outer inverse; C and D fail as unrestricted claims.
explanation_bn: x ≥ 0 এ 2 tan⁻¹ x = cos⁻¹((1 − x²)/(1 + x²)) সঠিক; অন্যগুলো সার্বিক নয়।
source: Udvash HSC Question Bank 2026; licensed redistribution; higher_mathematics p2 ch07; curated bilingual

stem_en: Which are true? (i) tan⁻¹ x + tan⁻¹ y = tan⁻¹((x+y)/(1−xy)) when xy < 1 (ii) cos⁻¹ x + cos⁻¹ y = cos⁻¹(xy − √((1−x²)(1−y²))) when x + y ≥ 0 (iii) sin⁻¹ x + sin⁻¹ y = sin⁻¹(x√(1−y²) + y√(1−x²)) when xy < 0 and x² + y² ≤ 1 — board form
stem_bn: বিপরীত ত্রিকোণমিতিক অভেদ— (i) xy < 1 হলে tan⁻¹ x + tan⁻¹ y = tan⁻¹((x+y)/(1−xy)) (ii) x+y ≥ 0 হলে cos⁻¹ x + cos⁻¹ y = cos⁻¹(xy − √((1−x²)(1−y²))) (iii) উপযুক্ত শর্তে sin⁻¹ যোগ অভেদ — কোনটি সঠিক?
explanation_en: Standard textbook conditions make (i) and (ii) true as stated; (iii) as printed often has incorrect sign/domain, so board keys pick i and ii.
explanation_bn: আদর্শ শর্তে (i) ও (ii) সত্য; মুদ্রিত (iii) প্রায়শই অসম্পূর্ণ, চাবি i ও ii।
source: Udvash HSC Question Bank 2026; licensed redistribution; higher_mathematics p2 ch07; curated bilingual

stem_en: If 2 tan⁻¹ √2 = θ, which are true? (i) tan θ = −2√2 (ii) cot θ = −1/(2√2) (iii) sin θ = 2√2 / 3
stem_bn: 2 tan⁻¹ √2 = θ হলে— (i) tan θ = −2√2 (ii) cot θ = −1/(2√2) (iii) sin θ = 2√2 / 3 — কোনটি সঠিক?
explanation_en: tan θ = 2√2/(1 − 2) = −2√2, so cot θ = −1/(2√2). Also sin θ = 2√2/(1 + 2) = 2√2/3. All three hold.
explanation_bn: tan θ = −2√2, cot θ = −1/(2√2), sin θ = 2√2/3; তিনটিই সত্য।
source: Udvash HSC Question Bank 2026; licensed redistribution; higher_mathematics p2 ch07; curated bilingual
